prompt: Using the provided reference image, transform this hand-painted digital artwork into a photorealistic cinematic photograph. Keep the composition of the weathered fighter plane and pilot identical, but render all surfaces with high-fidelity textures: replace the painterly brushstrokes on the fuselage with realistic oxidized metal, peeling paint, and rust. Render the pilot's gear as authentic leather and fabric. Convert the abstract background into a detailed aerial view of a burning landscape below, featuring volumetric smoke plumes, realistic fire glow, and atmospheric motion blur to simulate a high-speed dive.
